query: How do I update my new passport details with ICA if I am a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) holder?
reference_answer: You can report change in passport particulars via the e-Service. The LTVP holder will be required to upload an image of the new passport biodata page at the e-Service.You can refer to ICA website on Change of Passport Particulars or Residential Address for LTVP holders for further information.
answer: To update your LTVP details for a new passport, contact the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) directly. They will guide you through the process. [Document 1]
